about: CI measurements of every routed time bound, written by scripts/time-bounds-harvest.ts from the [time-bound] lines of real CI runs (failed AND passing). An assert-mode bound is calibrated only with n >= 5 runs, at least one of them on a slow runner (unitSuiteS >= slowRunnerFloorS), bound >= 2 x ciMax, and a bodyHash equal to its test body today. Never edited by hand.
